hotspots.name: The Gutter
hotspots.description: Ashfen Row runs downhill to the river and everything the Row is finished with goes with it. Tonight: a broken pipe stem, a playbill, and rain that has been falling since the twelfth.

hotspots.name: Halloway's Window
hotspots.description: The pawnshop's front window, shuttered from within. From the street you can see the nail heads through the gap in the boards.

hotspots.name: Parish Notice
hotspots.description: A constabulary bill, pasted crooked: EZRA HALLOWAY, of this parish, died the fifteenth instant. Any person with information &c. Somebody has written a rude word across it and somebody else has half scrubbed it off.
